crossRefs.note: Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!

people.name: Bakbukiah
people.line: A Levite who served in Jerusalem after the exile.

people.name: Unni
people.line: Postexilic Levite who assisted in the temple

translations.web: Also Bakbukiah and Unno, their brothers, were close to them according to their offices.
translations.bsb: Bakbukiah and Unni, their associates, stood across from them in the services.
translations.kjv: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in the watches.
translations.asv: Also Bakbukiah and Unno, their brethren, were over against them according to their offices.
